Power 
 Station | Technical 
 Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the 
equipment inspection list I1, which must be carried out every two months as 
indicated by M2 in the above title block.
This pump is used to transfer sea water for fire fighting system
The first draft initiated by eng. Abd El Naeem Attalla, reviewed by eng. Moneer 
Elbadry, revised by General Dercter eng. Gomah Lofty, revised by EDEPC 
Inspection and Quality Control eng. Medht Khater, eng. Abouda El Bana, and 
approved by eng. Mokhter Abd Elatif Head Sector of Ataka Power Station ( 2x300 + 
2x150 ) MW.
This document accepted by eng.
 Samir Abdel Gilel: EDEPC 
 inspection and 
 quality control general director & MPIS coordinator, and 
 certified by accountant: Mahmoud Mohamed Soliman EDEPC admin. & financial 
 inspection, quality control general director and supervisor of inspection & 
 quality control's head sector.
Pump Technical Specification:
Pump Type | Horizontal - Multi stage pump - HO 150A
Manufacture | HALBERGEK. HD FRANK FORT
Pump Fluid | Water
Capacity | 72.2 kg/s
PN | 15 bar
Temp. Fluid | 35 oC
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area 
 is required.
Wear safety and healthy equipments as safety healthy, 
 safety shoes, ...etc.
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area 
 is required.
Wear safety and healthy equipments as safety healthy, 
 safety shoes, ...etc.
Isolate the 
 circuit breaker of the pump motor.
Disconnect 
 electric terminals of the pump motor.
The pump must 
 be isolated mechanically by closing delivery and suction valves.
Be sure pump must 
 be completely drainage.
Tools and Equipment
Complete maintenance tool set.
Cleaning fluid, rags, suitable lifting device
Manual Puller, Feeler Gauges
Work to be Carried Out
Check any noise for vibration.
Check any leakage from the piping connection to pump.
Check the leakage from stuffing box and prevented it by re tighten the gland 
 bolts.
Check leakage of lubricating oil from bearing house.
Check the oil level.
Check the pressure in pump delivery.
Check the temperature of bearing house.
After Isolating the Pump (Mechanically & Elect.)
Check the coupling pins.
Change the packing if there is more leakage.
Prevent the leakage of lubricating oil.
Add lubricating oil to pump of the level less than 2/3 side glass.
Retighten the bolts connected pump and motor with 
 foundation.

Trouble Shooting
Trouble | Possible | Remedy
Pump does not apply amount | Suction line trouble | Check suction valve it must be opened.
 Check air tightness of suction piping.
Pump not primed | Prime the pump
Opposite sense of rotation | Check the rotation direction
Leakage in relief valve | Check the relief valve seat and also its spring
Excessive suction lift | Check the recommended specification
Excessive worn in rotating pistons and pump casing | Change the rotation piston and repair pump casing or changed it
Delivered amount is low | Suction line trouble | Check suction valve and it must be opened
 Check air tightness of suction piping
Pump speed are too low | Check the recommended specification
Clearance between rotating pistons bore or covers is too great | Change the worn parts
Mechanical impurities in the liquid | Check the filter before pump
Pump does not catch the prescribed pressure | Pressure gauge gives low pressure | Recalibrate the pressure gauge or renewed it
Clearance between the rotating pistons, body and covers is too great | Check or change worn parts of pump
Direct connection of suction with delivery happened in the pump | Dismantle the pump and check it
Excessive noise in pump | Air in pump casing | Check air-tightness of pump casing
Misalignment | Realignment the pump with motor and retighten all bolts of pump and motor 
 with foundation
Discharge pressure too high | Check the recommended discharge pressure
Bearing damage | Change the bearing
Excessive power consumption | Excessive dishrag pressure | Check the pressure gauge
Uncorrected assembly of pump | Mount the pump correctly
Cold liquid or 
 high viscosity | Measure the viscosity and temperature
Gland is tightening too much and heated | Check the mechanical seal and it must be leakage some drops of liquid to 
 cooling gland
Bearing damage | Check the bearing and exchanged it if needed
Pump speed higher than rated | Measure the pump speed
